brique._comment: Engine-native Matter family capacity. kind/wrapper/rel_ctx/lang do not apply here.

objective.name: matter.read_batch
objective.description: Read several matters in one request and return one per-item result entry.

#root.role: Resolve a list of matter identifiers, read the requested sections for each item, and return a fail-soft batch result.

matter_ids._comment: Ordered list of matter identifiers. Empty or blank-only lists are rejected.

read_mode._comment: Optional pipe-separated selector such as meaning|functional|data|brique. The four tokens are strictly disjoint — 'meaning' does NOT include 'functional' (meaning only assembles objective+subjective; request 'meaning|functional' to get both). When omitted, all sections are requested for each item. Same semantics as matter.read's read_mode.

want_meaning._comment: Ignored when read_mode is present. Has no effect when read_mode is absent. Kept for compatibility only — use read_mode.

want_functional._comment: Ignored when read_mode is present. Has no effect when read_mode is absent. Kept for compatibility only — use read_mode.

want_data._comment: Ignored when read_mode is present. Has no effect when read_mode is absent. Kept for compatibility only — use read_mode.

want_brique._comment: Ignored when read_mode is present. Has no effect when read_mode is absent. Kept for compatibility only — use read_mode.

result._comment: Ordered per-item result list. Each item on success: { ok: true, matter_id (string), meaning (object, when requested), functional (object, when requested), brique (object, when requested), data (object, when requested — same inline/http shape as matter.read: { kind: 'inline', bytes, size } or { kind: 'http', base_url, path, rid, tok, expires_at, revision, size_hint, method: 'GET' }) }. Each item on failure: { ok: false, matter_id (string), error: { code, message } }.

effects.catalog: Local matter catalog is consulted for every requested matter.
effects.substance_access: Each successful item may read inline substance or open an HTTP lease.

transformation_contract.morphing: A list of matter identifiers becomes an ordered batch of per-item success or error results, each carrying the requested matter sections when available.
invariants: The batch preserves the original identifier order after blank entries are discarded.
One failing item does not invalidate successful sibling items.
success: A successful batch response always returns result as one ordered list of per-item envelopes.
Each successful item contains ok=true plus the requested readable sections that could be assembled for that matter.
failure: The capacity fails terminally when matter_ids is missing or empty.
Per-item read failures are reported inside result entries rather than failing the whole batch.
notes: The batch uses fail-soft semantics: item-level errors are embedded in result instead of aborting the whole response.
The exact shape of each item's data field follows the same substance rules as matter.read.
